message.text: Design one production-ready native mobile screen for Akiba App: a swipe-based Business Offers discovery page reached from Explore. It is a stack route with a compact back header, not a bottom-tab screen. Show one dominant offer card with the next card subtly visible behind it. The card uses a merchant-authored image, a small Available now or Upcoming status, merchant name, offer title, a short description, schedule, and a quiet No AkibaMiles required label. Users swipe left for Not interested and right for Interested; reveal restrained decision stamps only while swiping. Below the card, use three thumb-friendly icon actions: dismiss, Remind me, and Interested. Reminder opens timing choices elsewhere, so do not add explanatory reminder copy here. Include a small progress count and an Undo affordance after a decision, but avoid onboarding instructions, paragraphs, decorative gradients, glass effects, or oversized headings. The screen must remain usable with long titles and missing images. Style direction: calm, tactile, editorial consumer utility using Akiba's near-black ink, warm off-white paper, white cards, restrained teal accents, and fine grey borders. Use Sterling-like confident display typography for the offer title and DM Sans-like neutral typography for utility text. Keep the hierarchy dense and mobile-first, with a high-image card, moderate rounded corners rather than excessive pills, border-led surfaces with only a soft stack shadow, familiar line icons, and motion implied by a slight card rotation and the offset next card. The memorable detail should be the crisp physical-card stack, not decorative chrome. Use honest content based on an Akiba Store weekend offer in Nairobi.
